caption: The drawing depicts a single, blue-colored vase with a wide, flat rim and a curved, tapering body that narrows at the neck before flaring out towards the base. The vase features vertical, elongated petal-like panels that start from the bottom and extend upward, adding texture and depth to the composition. The color palette consists primarily of varying shades of blue, giving the vase a sense of dimensionality through the use of light and shadow. The background is a plain, off-white or beige color, and a subtle rectangular border frames the image. There is a small, hand-drawn arrow pointing to the left on the lower left side of the vase, and the artist's signature, "N. Amantea," appears in the lower right corner of the drawing.
title: Blue Glass
